subject: JLG scissor-lift manufacture-year lookup

summary.interpretation: The official public lookup is useful but its observed dates are shipment, in-service and warranty dates. The research did not establish a manufacture-year decoder or annual serial ranges.

unverified: Coverage of every legacy or non-US serial
Any additional fields available to authorized account holders
An OEM-supported API or permission for bulk extraction
Exact manufacturing dates for these four machines

coverage.evidence_status: Country-prefix and manual-scope evidence; serial-specific date lookup verified for 1930ES only.
Live OEM guest result verified, including PVC; manufacture field absent in inspected machine information.
Manual serial applicability located; live OEM guest result is specifically 4394RT.
PVC-scoped RT/ERT manual and live OEM RT4069 guest result; no annual year map established.

unit_observations.input_provenance: Public lower serial boundary in JLG manual 3121656 Rev H.
prohibited_inferences: Do not relabel ship year, in-service year, warranty year or PVC digits as manufacture year.
Do not extrapolate an annual serial range from this isolated record.
Do not infer model from a family-wide manual serial boundary.

accepted_for_catalog: Preserve the exact date label and provenance when showing OEM lookup results.
Use model-specific manual scope for country-prefix or plate-location guidance.
Keep unknown manufacturing years null and visibly unresolved.
rejected_for_automatic_year_decoding: A 17-character VIN convention applied to JLG scissor serials without a model-specific OEM rule
Component dates or power-module design changes

details.usa_prefix_text_ambiguity: The same page gives 013 in its format example and 13 in its transition note; preserve raw wording.

next_evidence_needed: A clear original manufacturer plate with an explicit manufacture-date/year field, matched to the full serial and exact model.
Or a JLG/dealer record explicitly identifying the manufacturing date for the full serial.
Or an official model/region-scoped serial/year table or decoder with applicability bounds.
authorization: No accounts created, logins performed, manufacturer contacts sent or existing project records altered. This is additive research.

sources.title: JLG Online Express Equipment Information
sources.verification: Live guest lookup in dot cloud browser on 2026-10-17; four public serials submitted through search UI. Sign In remained available; no login was performed.
sources.supported_claim: Public serial-specific identity, ship date, in-service date, warranty end date and, on newer samples, PVC.
sources.limitation: No manufacturing date or manufacturing year field observed on the four machine-information results. Does not prove no other JLG system has that field.

sources.title: 19 Questions About Using JLG’s Online Express Site Answered
sources.supported_claim: Serial search in Equipment Information supports build-sheet/component research and the in-service date.
sources.limitation: FAQ does not describe that in-service date as a manufacture date.

sources.title: Product Variant Code (PVC) FAQs
sources.verification: Official-domain indexed PDF text retrieved; full PDF fetch failed, so no downloaded-copy or visual-verification claim.
sources.supported_claim: PVC identifies a six-month block with the same build and helps select the appropriate manual; it is on the serial tag and accessible by serial lookup.
sources.limitation: No PVC-character-to-individual-manufacture-date rule is supplied. A design/configuration block is not an exact build-date observation.

sources.title: ES Service and Maintenance Manual 3121656 Rev H
sources.verification: Existing downloaded official PDF and previously visually checked page 1-7, PDF page 19; preserved source record.
sources.supported_claim: 02 and B2 identify USA-built and China-built machines in this manual’s scope, respectively; left-rear plate location.
sources.limitation: Country-prefix evidence only, not a year decoder. The URL directory contains additional model names absent from the cover.
sources.correction_note: Replaced erroneous Skyjack manual URL with already reviewed JLG 3121656 Rev H source.

sources.title: ES Service and Maintenance Manual 3121166
sources.verification: Official PDF downloaded, and official web PDF text retrieved.
sources.supported_claim: The mid-2010 power-module change is discussed; later USA/Belgium machines may use either module, and China machines use the ZAPI module.
sources.limitation: Component-change chronology is not a dated annual serial range. Replaced components cannot establish a machine manufacture date.

sources.title: RT/ERT Operation and Safety Manual 31217162 Rev B
sources.verification: Official PDF downloaded and text inspected.
sources.supported_claim: A modern RT/ERT manual explicitly has PVC 2004 applicability.
sources.limitation: Its revision date and PVC are not an individual serial-to-manufacture-year mapping.

sources.title: 1230ES Illustrated Parts Manual 3121223 Rev AG
sources.verification: Official PDF downloaded; printed/PDF page 3 rendered and visually checked.
sources.supported_claim: France production Aug 2006–Feb 2010 ending at A200009897; Mexico begins Mar 2016 with M130000235; USA prefix changes in Jul 2015.
sources.limitation: 1230ES is a vertical-mast lift. The page mistakenly calls it a scissor lift; these facts are excluded from scissor-lift year rules. It gives no annual mapping.

sources.title: JLG 6V Battery compatibility list
sources.supported_claim: The manufacturer separately lists ES-series scissors and 1230ES under ES Vertical Mast.
sources.limitation: Used only to resolve equipment-class scope, not for dating.
